stem.text: Sodium chromate(VI), $\text{Na}_2\text{CrO}_4$, is manufactured by heating chromite, $\text{FeCr}_2\text{O}_4$, with sodium carbonate in an oxidising atmosphere. Chromite contains $\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_4^{2-}$ ions.

A.text: Chromium and iron are the only elements oxidised.

B.text: Chromium, iron and carbon are oxidised.
